definitionOfDone: Acceptance criteria reproduced by tests, negative permission test where relevant, strict TS, docs current, CI green on exact SHA, reviewer sign-off; no unsupported provider presented as ready.

epics.title: Governance, decisions and service compliance
epics.outcome: Architecture, permissions and independent provider policy decisions grounded in evidence

epics.title: OpenCode 2 native plugin and inference runtime
epics.outcome: Loadable plugin plus demonstrable model execution using a deterministic fixture

epics.title: Integrated browser driver and account sessions
epics.outcome: Permissioned tab/session control without credential export

epics.title: Conversation transport, structured tools and recovery
epics.outcome: Replay-safe turns, complete response handling and validated tools

epics.title: Security, isolation and privacy
epics.outcome: Auditable permission boundaries and threat-driven negative tests

epics.title: Provider adapters and validation
epics.outcome: Five individually gated adapters conforming to a common capability contract

epics.title: Native user experience and operations
epics.outcome: Transparent configuration, model selection, status and diagnostics in OpenCode

epics.title: Projects, workers and multi-agent execution
epics.outcome: Correct tool/session ownership and safe collaboration across agents and worktrees

epics.title: Quality, releases and maintenance
epics.outcome: Reproducible, tested and documented releases with rollback path

stories.need: record design decisions as ADRs
accept: ADR template and decision log committed
provider, browser and security decisions link to evidence

stories.need: audit API and web automation rules for each provider
accept: five dated provider rule assessments with source links
blocked providers remain disabled without workarounds

stories.need: record Chat On Steroids source provenance and licenses
accept: copied files retain original notices
third-party attribution and modifications documented

stories.need: maintain a threat model and trust-boundary diagram
accept: assets, attackers, entry points, mitigations documented
negative tests mapped to identified threats

stories.need: trace work from user story through proof gate to release
stories.value: see meaningful progress without fake completion
accept: all stories have IDs, dependencies, acceptance and verification
gate status cannot be marked passing without evidence

stories.need: document explicit go/no-go decisions per provider
accept: per-provider decisions have owner/date/version
unknown and denied are treated as disabled

stories.need: load and unload the plugin on actual OpenCode 2.0.29
accept: standalone smoke report of loaded plugin and cleanup
no global OpenCode config or credentials modified

stories.need: prove a real model runtime can answer from a local fixture
stories.value: distinguish inference execution from model picker metadata
accept: native model selection and request produce expected fixture output
abort and error propagation recorded

stories.need: define typed provider capabilities and activation states
accept: all five providers start disabled
unknown capability cannot be interpreted as supported

stories.need: register only proven models in native picker
stories.value: avoid dead or misleading model choices
accept: inert plugin publishes no models
a ready mock transport may register only mock model

stories.need: configure runtime via validated local settings
accept: schema validates explicit enablement and addresses
invalid configuration fails closed with actionable error

stories.need: track compatible OpenCode and SDK versions
accept: tested 2.0.29 baseline and SDK versions documented
unsupported version is reported, not silently assumed

stories.need: prove whether plugins can control the integrated browser
accept: supported API proof or documented negative result
chosen fallback design has security rationale

stories.need: implement a browser port with deterministic fake
accept: browser port exposes explicit scoped tab operations
fake requires no network or account

stories.need: bind a visible tab to exactly one local session
accept: same tab cannot silently serve unrelated accounts
closing/replacing tab invalidates the binding

stories.need: log in manually without giving credentials to plugin
accept: no cookie, token, password or localStorage export interface
logged-out state pauses instead of retrying credentials

stories.need: receive the correct settled answer amid loading and redraws
accept: settled/final barriers are explicit
DOM redesign results in safe unavailable state

stories.need: control navigation and close browser work cleanly
stories.value: prevent surprise tab or account activity
accept: navigation restricted to approved origins
abort/close releases tab ownership

stories.need: use one typed conversation transport across adapters
accept: send/observe/cancel/reconcile contract versioned
invalid provider or incomplete state fails closed

stories.need: stream responses with coherent turn identity
stories.value: see progress without repeated or cross-turn text
accept: ordered chunk/finish events tagged by turn
bounded buffers handle large or malformed output

stories.need: parse structured tool requests with schemas
stories.value: treat generated text as untrusted proposals
accept: unknown action or bad arguments refused
no response text directly invokes OS commands

stories.need: execute approved tools at most once
accept: durable operation journal and terminal states
uncertain operations require reconciliation, not retries

stories.need: resume sessions after browser reload or process crash
accept: session/browser/conversation identity restored only after verification
ambiguous delivery never silently resends

stories.need: reliably handle timeout, cancel and media capability errors
stories.value: receive actionable states instead of hangs
accept: timeout/backoff bounded and cancel truthful
unsupported attachments fail before uploading

stories.need: enforce OpenCode's native tool permission boundary
accept: all tool effects gated by OpenCode approvals
deny stays deny across workers and retries

stories.need: prevent credentials from leaking to files, logs or other sites
accept: tokens/cookies never exported
logs redact secrets and URL auth

stories.need: prevent cross-session data disclosure
stories.value: isolate providers, tabs, workers and accounts
accept: opaque IDs tied to local owner authority
malicious worker cannot take over another binding

stories.need: prevent untrusted page content from issuing commands
stories.value: resist injection through web page or model output
accept: DOM/results treated strictly as data
unvalidated instructions cannot trigger tool requests

stories.need: protect any local bridge from network abuse
stories.value: avoid SSRF, CSRF and remote access
accept: no listener or public tunnel by default
if needed, loopback-only nonce/auth plus origin and destination controls

stories.need: bound work, logs and external service requests
stories.value: avoid unexpected usage, disk growth and quota evasion
accept: rate/concurrency/retry caps configurable and safe
clear deletion/export policy for local transcripts

stories.need: validate all adapters against one compliance/capability contract
accept: compatibility test harness shared by all adapters
only verified technical and contractual allowances enable transport

stories.value: use my chat account in OpenCode
accept: explicit legal/technical gate recorded
login/logout, message completion and errors tested

accept: explicit legal/technical gate recorded

accept: explicit legal/technical gate recorded
login/logout, message completion and errors tested

stories.need: install and configure the plugin from OpenCode
accept: documented local and published installation paths
uninstall and rollback leave OpenCode untouched

stories.need: see genuinely usable providers and models only
accept: enabled models in picker reflect evidence/state
no model available means explicit unavailable message

stories.need: link and inspect my visible web tabs
accept: manual pair/unpair UI with provider and account scope
never displays raw login tokens

stories.need: see generating, awaiting consent, blocked and retry states
accept: typed status visible for each session
clear distinction between failed and unconfirmed

stories.need: stop work and inspect activity safely
accept: cancel does not claim success without confirmation
redacted diagnostics export has no secrets

stories.need: use onboarding/docs in French and English
accept: FR/EN messages cover provider status and errors

stories.need: bind agent tasks to the correct OpenCode session
accept: parent/child session identities explicit

stories.need: delegate to multiple web providers where permitted
accept: independent provider/account limits enforced

stories.need: use native Git worktrees and tools
accept: per-worker cwd/worktree provenance

stories.need: compact and resume long tasks without lost requirements
accept: durable handoff includes current state and exact provenance
replacement session reconciles prior operations

stories.need: set agent concurrency and work limits
accept: explicit caps per provider and globally
no behavior designed to evade account limits

stories.need: receive traceable task/test reports from workers
accept: worker reports link to executed operations and status
uncertain or unverified results remain clearly marked

stories.need: continuous checks for builds, tests and secrets
accept: CI Linux and Windows validate TypeScript and tests
secret/dependency auditing wired to failures

stories.need: run deterministic web fixture end-to-end
accept: reproducible offline fixture tests
race, lost tab, interrupted turn and changed DOM scenarios

stories.need: run a version/OS compatibility matrix
accept: tested OpenCode and SDK SHA/version recorded
Windows/macOS/Linux decisions evidenced or blocked
stories.test: matrix CI or documented manual test

stories.need: verify release artifacts and rollback
accept: signed or checksum-verifiable reproducible package
rollback tested on clean profile

stories.need: clear support, troubleshooting and security disclosure docs
accept: README/docs FR/EN and support matrix accurate
private vulnerability reporting directions complete

stories.need: know when upstream UI or terms change
